_README: WHICH TEST FIXTURES CARRY REAL BYTES — one entry per file under capture-host/tests that holds an ISO timestamp, a hex
literal of 24+ bytes, or is not a .py file. Gated by tests/test_fixture_provenance.py as an EQUALITY: a new such file
fails until classified here. Classes: captured (bytes from a real device, host or night) · derived (values transcribed
from a real night or its audit) · format (a real layout or header, no data) · synthetic (constructed or standard
vectors) · authored (built in the test). A file holding any address not in `synthetic_addresses` is `captured`: an
address identifies the owner's hardware. `sha256` pins a whole-file capture (non-.py); a .py entry is held by the
address rule instead, because a whole-module hash would fail every edit to the test. tools/codex-export.mjs omits
